description: This Java file defines the REST controller `NoteController` for handling CRUD operations related to notes in a web application. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes associated with authenticated users.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller providing API endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, with user authentication handling.

methods.name: resolveUser
methods.description: Resolves the User entity associated with the authenticated user's details.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new note for the authenticated user.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list notes of the authenticated user with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific note by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing note owned by the authenticated user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a note owned by the authenticated user.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a Note entity to its corresponding Data Transfer Object for response.
